Commentary: Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Tim Seifert, FOUR, 131kph, full and wide, another attempted wide yorker that hasn't been perfectly executed, it's short of the blockhole and Seifert slices it over short third
First look at Varun in this series
Varun Chakaravarthy, right-arm leg break, comes into the attack
Huge shout for LBW but Mitchell is very far down the pitch. Oh they've gone for the review.

Varun Chakaravarthy to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run, huge shout for LBW but Mitchell is very far down the pitch. Oh they've gone for the review. Scrambled seam googly on off, he advances, looks to flick it away but is hit on the pad. Sonic confirms there's an inside edge involved. Wasn't a great review in any case with Mitchell so far down. Impact seemed to be marginal too
Varun Chakaravarthy to Tim Seifert, 1 run, flat googly at the stumps, back of a length, and Seifert punches it from the crease to long-on
Varun Chakaravarthy to Daryl Mitchell, wide, down the leg-side, another googly perhaps, and Mitchell doesn't get anything on it
Varun Chakaravarthy to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run, pushed through flat, it's back of a length just outside off, and Mitchell drags it off the inside half through midwicket
Varun Chakaravarthy to Tim Seifert, 1 run, legbreak now, it's good length on middle, turns away, Seifert goes back and works it down to long-on

Varun Chakaravarthy to Daryl Mitchell, SIX, fired in at 105kph, hard to use the feet against that kind of pace but Mitchell still advances and flicks it so beautifully over long-on. It was on the pads, not giving him much swinging room, so he relied on the timing instead

Varun Chakaravarthy to Daryl Mitchell, no run, almost a celebrappeal from Varun but that is nowhere close to being out. Impact outside off as Mitchell looks to defend this googly from the crease, and probably bouncing over the stumps too
Prince Yadav [1.0-0-14-0] is back into the attack
Prince Yadav to Tim Seifert, no run, length ball following Seifert as he backs away, it zips through and smashes him on the pad after cramping him for room
Prince Yadav to Tim Seifert, 1 run, full delivery speared in on leg, he clears the front leg and swipes it to deep midwicket
Prince Yadav to Daryl Mitchell, leg byes, 1 run, low full toss down leg, Mitchell misses the flick and is hit on the pad

Prince Yadav to Daryl Mitchell, SIX, that's gone like a rocket over the ropes! Dug in on a short of length, it's around the chest and Mitchell couldn't have hit that pull shot any better. No great pace from Prince either - 136kph - won't trouble him at that pace and that height
Prince Yadav to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run, full toss on middle and leg, punched down to long-on
Prince Yadav to Tim Seifert, 1 run, very full on middle and leg, Seifert backs away, makes room and crunches it to deep point
Varun Chakaravarthy to Tim Seifert, no run, dragged down short, he goes hard on the pull and drags it off the under-edge onto pad
Varun Chakaravarthy to Tim Seifert, 1 run, to deep backward point
Varun Chakaravarthy to Daryl Mitchell, THATS OUT!! Caught!!
